title: LordBeck's Boredom Item Overlay
description: Pack made by LordBeck when he was bored in online class. This version only changes the item textures so that you can pair it with any resourcepack of your liking.
body:
LordBeck's Boredom Item Overlay is a simple pvp-aimed item overlay made by LordBeck when he was bored during class. The Item Overlay version uses the item textures from [LordBeck's Boredom Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/lordbeck-boredom-pack) without changing the block and gui textures, allowing for use with other resourcepacks.



![The new sword and apple textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17879a6be5016b023e3731d93d76ead52816ce45.png)
![slimeball, fireball, magma cream, ender pearl textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11d66a61649613149457776f8c6b33c6250970d2.png)

__Note: The wool texture here is the 1.14 texture from the standard version of the pack. It is not included in the overlay.__

_This page only includes the "correct" version of the overlay, since the originally uploaded version also had gui, font, and other texture changes. You can find all of the older versions on the old [CurseForge page](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/lordbecks-boredom-item-overlay)._
